text.autoconfig.better-bundle.title: Better Bundle
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.sho: Show the category buttons on the left of the panel. When off, use the search box to find items.
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.pan: Whether the panel is shown by default.
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.min: Minimum delay between two sort actions. Lower = faster but more packets.
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.max: Maximum delay between two sort actions.
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.con: Give up (and roll back) if the server does not confirm an action within this many ticks.
text.autoconfig.better-bundle.option.max: Refuse a single sort that needs more actions than this (asks you to sort in batches).
